name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, polished set of website building-blocks (buttons, forms, themes) that both human designers and AI coding tools can use to build a professional-looking site fast.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small agency that builds client sites quickly and wants a professional base look without hiring a designer for every project.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it as the base for every new client site, cutting build time and billing a flat 'fast launch' package.
A template marketplace seller builds and sells pre-themed Astryx starter kits (e.g. 'SaaS landing page kit') as one-off downloads.
A low-code agency offers 'AI-built, on-brand websites' using Astryx themes customized per client, sold as a short project.

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-themed starter-kit templates built on it
Agency retainer using it as the standard build stack

steal_this: Build and sell a pack of five ready-themed Astryx landing-page templates this weekend on a template marketplace like Gumroad.
